Name: Magical Broomstick
Author: JennaJuffuffles
Description:
The Wizard has a very practical idea, if you could bring him a solar essence. This mod adds an in-universe story for your player character to acquire their very own magical broomstick mount! Get swept up in all this immersion.

[b][size=4][color=#c9daf8]Features ✧ °｡⋆✦･ﾟ ✧[/color][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Magical Broomstick[/b] adds a broom any witch or wizard would be proud to fly as a custom mount.[/*]
[*][b]Strong Enchantments[/b] [i]can[/i] make your broom fly much faster than any horse could gallop if you keep the enchantment maintained! (Hint: 🚫🥕)[/*]
[*][b]Broom Closet[/b] is the perfect place to keep your broom![/*]
[*][b]Broom Flute[/b] is something any enchanted broom user might desire![/*]
[*][b]New events [/b]include a longer (skippable) event with the Wizard and a quick discovery later.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43704/43704-1773878499-1776456358.png[/img]
[i]Pick your broomstick with 8 stylish options to choose from![/i]
[i] [/i]
[b][size=3]✧ Requirements ✧[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35810]Custom Mounts[/url] (aedenthorn)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Includes Compatibly Styled Broom Closets:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2995]A Wittily Named Recolor[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Daisy Niko's Earthy Recolour[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Gwen's Medieval Buildings[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27579]Italian Countryside Buildings[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41878]Tanga's Forest Buildings Refreshed[/url] [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43704/43704-1773877949-1927972094.gif[/img]

[b][color=#c9daf8]A Note About Horses ✧[/color][/b]
[list]
[*]You can still build a normal stable and have a normal horse. Or an abnormal horse and stable if that's your thing.[/*]
[*]This is not a 'horse replacer' but other mods that effect horses and stables may also effect it or cause unusual behavior.[/*]
[*]If you are using [b]Horse Overhaul[/b], adjust its configuration from the title menu for the best results. Set: "Visible Saddle Bags" to Disabled; Click the checkbox for Disable Stable Sprite Changes and for Disable Horse Sounds, Disable the checkbox for "Fix Horse Emote Position". -- Options that modify the stable may overwrite the Broom Closet's appearance!
I have not tested the other features of Horse Overhaul with Custom Mounts, open to feedback. If you still want a horse saddlebag visual, I recommend adding them back with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8018]original standalone saddlebags[/url] otherwise they are also applied to the Broom (and look hella weird)[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43704/43704-1773678756-183599980.gif[/img]
[i]The Natural Broom has a lot of personality. Shadow is from the mod Dynamic Shader. Static shadows are also an option![/i]

[b][size=3]✧ Unlock & progression ✧ [/size][/b]
[b]Immersive (default)[/b] must be enabled in configuration.
[spoiler]
[b]Event and unlock summary[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Wizard mail sent after Wizard 2♥[/b] – Request for Solar Essence.[/*]
[*][b]Wizard Tower event[/b] – Bring Solar Essence to the Wizard's tower; He delivers it once you have a Broom Closet.[/*]
[*][b]Broom Closet[/b] – Unlocks at Robin's after the Wizard Tower event. Build cost: 10,000g, 100 Hardwood, 5 Iron Bars.[/*]
[*][b]Broom Flute[/b] – After the player returns the Magical Ink to the Wizard (vanilla quest); a Broom Closet must have been built. Visit Witch's Hut to find the Broom Flute.[/*]
[*][b]Qi's shop[/b] – Broom Flute for 50 Qi Gems[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[i][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/43704/43704-1773878735-491513818.png[/img]
Shadows and Bag Visual: two of the new togglable options in Update 1.0.1! Adjust the configuration with Generic Mod Config Manager![/i]

[b][size=3]✧ Configuration ✧ [/size][/b]
[spoiler]
Edit [b]config.json[/b] or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (recommended).

[list]
[*][b]Immersive[/b] – true/false. When false, no story events: Broom Closet and Broom Flute are available at shops right away.[/*]
[*][b]Building style[/b] – Auto / vanilla / tanga / earthy / medieval. Broom Closet look. Auto picks Tanga if Forest Buildings is installed, Earthy / Medieval if those packs are installed.[/*]
[*][b]Broom style[/b] – Default, Earthy, Glinda, Iridium, Rosy, Sunflower, Swamp, Tulip. Which broom sprite to use.[/*]
[*][b]Broom shadow[/b] – true/false. Shadow under the broom.[/*]
[*][b]Broom hands[/b] – true/false. Tries to hide reins in the farmer's hands while riding. [i]Does not remove reins if Fashion Sense is overriding farmer sprites.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Broom bag[/b] – true/false. Bag on the broom (look only).[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
